page_title: LEE 3-1 NOT | Leeds v Nottingham Forest 06/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+9' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) took the corner.

90+9' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Karl Darlow is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Nottingham have a corner.
90+8' Ola Aina (Nottingham) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
90+6' The game has come to an end for Jayden Bogle. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Sebastiaan Bornauw (Leeds).

90+4' Luca Netz (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball has crossed the sideline. Nottingham are taking a throw-in.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
89' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham).

88' Nottingham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

86' 3 - 1 Goooooal! Omari Hutchinson beats his man and slings in a cross towards Lorenzo Lucca (Nottingham), who evades his marker and plants a fine header into the top right corner from close in. 3:1.
85' Nottingham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
82' Noah Okafor goes off the pitch and Sean Longstaff (Leeds) comes on.
80' Leeds are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
78' Daniel Farke has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel James (Leeds) replacing Brenden Aaronson.
76' Substitution. Zach Abbott makes way for Luca Netz (Nottingham).
75' The corner from Dan Ndoye (Nottingham) is intercepted by the defence.
74' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham), but one of the defenders gets it clear. Nottingham will take a corner kick.
73' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

73' Nottingham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
71' Ilia Gruev (Leeds) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
67' Sean Dyche has decided to substitute Callum Hudson-Odoi and he is replaced by Dan Ndoye (Nottingham).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Morgan Gibbs-White leaves the pitch and Ryan Yates (Nottingham) comes on.
66' Ilia Gruev (Leeds) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
65' James Justin (Leeds) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
65' Nottingham are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
62' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
61' Noah Okafor (Leeds) has tested the patience of referee Peter Bankes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
59' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for an infringement.
57' Nottingham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
54' Here is a change. Igor Jesus is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Lorenzo Lucca (Nottingham).
54' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nicolas Dominguez walks off the pitch to be replaced by Omari Hutchinson (Nottingham).
53' Pascal Struijk (Leeds) commits a rough challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
51' Leeds are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
49' 3 - 0 GOAL! Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) reacts first to the lofted pass and calmly guides the ball into the net with his body.
49' Noah Okafor (Leeds) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block.

48' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nottingham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
46' Leeds show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The linesman signals a throw-in for Leeds.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' The corner from Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is hurriedly cleared.

44' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the right side of the target, but Karl Darlow keeps it out with an amazing save. Nottingham win a corner.
42' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
40' Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
38' The corner from Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) is cleared away by the defence.
37' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. The referee signals a corner kick to Nottingham.
37' Nottingham are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
34' Nottingham are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
33' Peter Bankes couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) and blew his whistle.

32' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Nottingham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
30' 2 - 0 Goal Noah Okafor (Leeds)! Noah Okafor (Leeds) was put through by James Justin and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
26' 1 - 0 Jayden Bogle (Leeds) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
24' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Leeds) leaps high to meet a lofted pass around the penalty spot, but his header crashes against the crossbar!
23' James Justin (Leeds) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
23' A cross from Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. Leeds force their opponents to concede a corner.

22' Leeds slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

21' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Igor Jesus (Nottingham). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leeds.
18' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
16' Wonderful movement by Nottingham. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
13' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the left post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
13' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) will take the corner.
13' Igor Jesus (Nottingham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham have been awarded a corner kick.
12' None of the Nottingham players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
11' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

11' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Karl Darlow pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the top left corner. Nottingham get a corner.
9' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from James Justin (Leeds). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

9' Noah Okafor (Leeds) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Leeds.
7' Noah Okafor (Leeds) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Nottingham will have a goal kick.
5' The corner is swung in but Leeds can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

5' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Leeds will take a corner.
3' James Justin (Leeds) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.

3' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Leeds) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Leeds are awarded a corner kick.
2' Leeds seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' Noah Okafor (Leeds) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Leeds will kick the game off.
